title: review: H4 fix round 8: the reservation ledger and notified_state live only in their own flock-guarded file and are never serialized by Pool.save(), so a long-lived Pool snapshot cannot overwrite concurrent reservations (review T-0413)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain the T-0362 lineage through 5976bb2 (T-0411) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Review T-0413 on T-0411, one high finding: Pool.save() (pool.py:204) blindly serializes self.reservations, reservation_history and notified_state while reserve(), release() and sweep_reservations() do locked read-modify-write through _reservation_file(); every Pool() keeps its own snapshot and Pool objects live across long operations (executor._run holds one through a subprocess of up to 1800 s and then calls pool.save() after a rate-limit hit at executor.py:126), so a stale snapshot overwrites reservations made meanwhile. This is the same hazard that leaked the executor running counters before H5a.
Fix: (1) remove reservations, reservation_history and notified_state from what Pool.save() writes and from what Pool() loads into mutable attributes; they live exclusively in the reservation file (or a separate reservations.json and notified.json under STATE) and are read fresh, under the flock, inside reserve(), release(), heartbeat(), sweep_reservations(), live_reservations() and the notify-per-transition helper; Pool.save() keeps writing only account and executor cooldowns and day counters. (2) Any code that read pool.reservations or pool.notified_state as attributes now calls the locked accessors. (3) Test: tests/test_pool.py::test_save_never_overwrites_concurrent_reservations (Pool A loads, Pool B reserves, Pool A saves a cooldown change; B's reservation is still in the file), and ::test_notified_state_survives_pool_save. Keep every lineage test green (reservation, estimate, goal cap, notify, dispatch, fallback hand-off, thread registry). Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root twice (exit 0 both), then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 5976bb2 and the rest of the T-0362 lineage below your commit
grep shows Pool.save() writes no reservations, reservation_history or notified_state keys and no code reads them as plain Pool attributes

tests/test_pool.py reservation tests, tests/test_daemon.py::test_notify_once_per_transition, ::test_budget_refusal_leaves_task_queued_without_repair, ::test_dispatch_passes_no_placeholder_ids and tests/test_executor.py::test_fallback_handoff_keeps_reservation_until_worker_finishes, ::test_worker_refusal_requeues_without_hold still pass
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree on two consecutive runs
